games.title: VVVVVV
games.note: Release 2.4.x ships SDL2.dll and calls SDL_CreateRenderer(window, -1, ...). SDL2 tries the D3D9 'direct3d' driver first on Windows, and the game accepts '-renderer <name>' (e.g. -renderer opengl) to override the driver. PCGW lists the Windows exe as 32-bit. (high) SDL2 renderer, Direct3D 9 by default; -renderer opengl switches to OpenGL.
games.uhd_note:
